slots.name: Unabomber deaths
slots.sentence: The trip eventually led him to Mumbai, where he met with a writer who shared Mr. Mangione’s interest in Ted Kaczynsk i, the mathematician known as the Unabomber whose nearly 20-year bombing spree killed three people and injured 23 others.
